title: Ocular refractive error predicted effector genes (Tedja MS et al. 2018)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genome-wide association meta-analysis highlights light-induced signaling as a driver for refractive error.
Tedja MS, et al.
Nat Genet. 2018 Jun;50(6):834-848. doi: 10.1038/s41588-018-0127-7.
PMID: 29808027

The authors performed a GWAS for ocular refractive errors in 160,420 individuals from a mixed-ancestry population and replicated associations of the index variants in 95,505 individuals from the UK Biobank. They then considered 10 evidence types to prioritize a predicted effector gene at each genetically associated locus.

In the table below, drug target information is displayed for the predicted effector genes but was not included in the gene score. Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.
